errors.text_span: всяка стълба представлява броят на фирмите
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis represents percentages, not the absolute number of companies. Therefore, each bar represents the percentage of firms, not the count.
Not all intervals on the y-axis are five years long. For example, 1990-1995 and 1996-2001 are six-year intervals. This is an incorrect generalization about the categories.

errors.text_span: Периодите 1996-2001 и 2002-2007 съответстват на стълбове с приблизително равни височини, около 18%
errors.evidence: The bars for these two periods are not of approximately equal height. The bar for 1996-2001 is about 18%, but the one for 2002-2007 is visibly shorter, at about 17%. Stating both are 'around 18%' is inaccurate for the 2002-2007 period.

errors.text_span: всеки стълб е изобразен със синя градиентна заливка, без допълнителни визуални акценти или засенчвания
errors.evidence: This description of the visual style is incorrect in two ways: 1) The bars are a solid blue color, not a gradient fill. 2) The bars have a clear drop shadow effect ('засенчване'), which the description explicitly denies.
